title: [ALAppExtensions #30229][Event Request] table 12113 "Tmp Withholding Contribution"
summary: Adds an IsHandled event OnCalculateWithholdingTaxOnBeforeAssignWithholdingTaxValues to the Tmp Withholding Contribution table and extracts field assignments into a separate procedure to allow customization of withholding tax calculation logic.
key_points: New IsHandled event lets extensions override withholding tax value assignments
Standard field assignment logic extracted into AssignWithholdingTaxValues local procedure
Negative taxable base validation remains outside the handled block to prevent bypass
Default behavior unchanged for systems not overriding the event
Low-risk change with backward compatibility maintained
